visual.description: Full-viewport hero with oversized red display text ('MATHESON FOOD COMPANY') filling the entire background on a light gray field, text cropped at edges.
Sticky top navigation bar spanning full width with left-aligned text links, centered logo wordmark, and right-aligned utility links plus social icon.
Three equal-width columns: left red panel with black text label ('QUALITY'), center column with a full-bleed close-up food photograph, right red panel with black text label ('FLAVOR').
A single horizontal scrolling marquee ticker spanning full width listing product category names separated by bullet points.
Three equal columns in a grid: left column is a blue color-block with a text label and badge, center and right columns show product photography on gray backgrounds with product names beneath.
Three equal columns continuing the product grid: left is a green color-block with category name text, center and right show product packaging photography on gray with product names below.
Three equal columns: left is a yellow-olive color-block with category label text, center and right columns display glass bottle product photography on gray backgrounds with product names.
Three equal columns: left red color-block, center and right columns with bottle product photography and product name labels beneath.
Three equal columns where one contains bold all-caps editorial text 'WHERE TO FIND US' and adjacent columns hold product photography.
Two equal-width columns: left has a portrait photograph, right has a red background with body copy text quote.
Full-width gray section with centered all-caps heading 'COOK LIKE A MATHESON' at large display size.
Two equal-width columns each containing a recipe thumbnail image with a bold all-caps recipe title overlaid at the bottom of each card.
A white modal dialog centered over the full-page content with a close button, red headline text, email input field, checkbox with legal copy, and a full-width red submit button.
